component.name: influxdb2
component.title: InfluxDB2
component.description: Write time series data to InfluxDB 2.x.
component.label: database

influxDBClient.description: The com.influxdb.client.InfluxDBClient that all endpoints use. When it is set or autowired, the connectionBean of an endpoint is not looked up in the registry. The component does not close this client.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelInfluxDB2MeasurementName.description: The key of the measurement name in a Map body, which the producer converts to a Point whose fields are the other entries of the Map. The producer does not read a message header of this name.

camelInfluxDB.RetentionPolicy.deprecationNote: Never read by the component: the InfluxDB 2.x write API has no retention policy, retention is a property of the bucket
camelInfluxDB.RetentionPolicy.description: The name of a retention policy, which InfluxDB 1.x has and InfluxDB 2.x does not. Deprecation note: Never read by the component: the InfluxDB 2.x write API has no retention policy, retention is a property of the bucket

CamelInfluxDB2Org.description: The name of the organization to write to, overriding the org option on the endpoint.

CamelInfluxDB2Bucket.description: The name of the bucket to write to, overriding the bucket option on the endpoint.

CamelInfluxDB2WritePrecision.description: The precision of the timestamps in a Measurement, Record, Measurements or Records body, which replaces the writePrecision option. It does not apply to a Point, a Map or a Points body.

producerIn.description: A com.influxdb.client.write.Point, or the Measurement, Record, Points, Measurements or Records wrappers of the component (package org.apache.camel.component.influxdb2.data), or a Map of the field names and their values with the measurement name under the CamelInfluxDB2MeasurementName key. Text, a List or an annotated class that is not wrapped fail: wrap a line protocol String in a Record and an annotated object in a Measurement. A Point without a field that has a value (also from a Map or in Points) fails the exchange, as the client would skip it. Ping does not read the body

producerOut.description: An insert leaves the body unchanged; ping gives a Boolean, true when the server answered

connectionBean.description: The name of the com.influxdb.client.InfluxDBClient bean to look up in the registry. It is not looked up when the component has a client, set with its influxDBClient option or autowired.

autoCreateBucket.description: Whether the endpoint looks up the bucket of the bucket option when it starts, and creates it in the organization of the org option when it does not exist. If autoCreateOrg is false and that organization does not exist, the endpoint fails to start. A bucket that the CamelInfluxDB2Bucket header names is not created. Not used by the PING operation.

autoCreateOrg.description: Whether the endpoint looks up the organization of the org option when it starts, and creates it when it does not exist. An organization that the CamelInfluxDB2Org header names is not created. Not used by the PING operation.

bucket.description: The name of the bucket to write to. The CamelInfluxDB2Bucket header replaces this option for a write, so the option can be left out when autoCreateBucket is false. The autoCreateBucket option uses this bucket when the endpoint starts, and the endpoint fails to start without it. Not used by the PING operation.

operation.description: The operation of the producer. INSERT writes the body to the bucket. PING calls the ping endpoint of InfluxDB and sets the body to a Boolean: true when InfluxDB answered with success, false otherwise.

org.description: The name of the organization to write to. The CamelInfluxDB2Org header replaces this option for a write, so the option can be left out when autoCreateOrg and autoCreateBucket are false. The autoCreateOrg and autoCreateBucket options use this organization when the endpoint starts: with autoCreateOrg, or with autoCreateBucket and a bucket that does not exist yet, the endpoint fails to start without it. Not used by the PING operation.

retentionPolicy.deprecationNote: Never read by the component: the InfluxDB 2.x write API has no retention policy, retention is a property of the bucket
retentionPolicy.description: The name of a retention policy, which InfluxDB 1.x has and InfluxDB 2.x does not. Deprecation note: Never read by the component: the InfluxDB 2.x write API has no retention policy, retention is a property of the bucket

writePrecision.description: The precision of the timestamps in a Measurement, Record, Measurements or Records body. It does not apply to a Point, a Map or a Points body, as the client writes each Point with its own precision (ns unless set with Point.time). The CamelInfluxDB2WritePrecision header replaces this option.

By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
